account_setup_tokens_terminal_state_vali.name: account_setup_tokens_terminal_state_valid
account_setup_tokens_terminal_state_vali.value: NOT ("account_setup_tokens"."used_at" IS NOT NULL AND "account_setup_tokens"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL)

assignments_money_nonnegative.name: assignments_money_nonnegative
assignments_money_nonnegative.value: "assignments"."talent_rate_cents" >= 0 AND ("assignments"."talent_rate_override_cents" IS NULL OR "assignments"."talent_rate_override_cents" >= 0) AND "assignments"."total_compensation_cents" >= 0 AND ("assignments"."fixed_fee_cents" IS NULL OR "assignments"."fixed_fee_cents" >= 0) AND ("assignments"."paid_amount_cents" IS NULL OR "assignments"."paid_amount_cents" >= 0)

assignments_paid_complete.name: assignments_paid_complete
assignments_paid_complete.value: "assignments"."payout_status" <> 'paid' OR ("assignments"."paid_at" IS NOT NULL AND "assignments"."paid_amount_cents" IS NOT NULL AND "assignments"."payment_reference" IS NOT NULL)

daypart_date_exceptions_fields_valid.name: daypart_date_exceptions_fields_valid
daypart_date_exceptions_fields_valid.value:
("daypart_date_exceptions"."kind" = 'skip' AND "daypart_date_exceptions"."start_minute" IS NULL AND "daypart_date_exceptions"."end_minute" IS NULL)
    OR
    ("daypart_date_exceptions"."kind" = 'override' AND "daypart_date_exceptions"."start_minute" >= 0 AND "daypart_date_exceptions"."start_minute" < 1440 AND "daypart_date_exceptions"."end_minute" > "daypart_date_exceptions"."start_minute" AND "daypart_date_exceptions"."end_minute" <= "daypart_date_exceptions"."start_minute" + 1440)

dayparts_type_fields_valid.name: dayparts_type_fields_valid
dayparts_type_fields_valid.value:
("dayparts"."type" = 'house_activity' AND "dayparts"."billing_mode" IS NULL AND "dayparts"."default_talent_rate_cents" IS NULL)
    OR
    ("dayparts"."type" = 'dj_artist' AND "dayparts"."billing_mode" = 'tracking_only' AND "dayparts"."default_talent_rate_cents" IS NULL)
    OR
    ("dayparts"."type" = 'dj_artist' AND "dayparts"."billing_mode" = 'billed_by_hfy')

invoices_approved_has_pdf.name: invoices_approved_has_pdf
invoices_approved_has_pdf.value: "invoices"."status" NOT IN ('approved', 'sent', 'paid') OR "invoices"."pdf_storage_path" IS NOT NULL

platform_settings_logo_metadata_complete.name: platform_settings_logo_metadata_complete
platform_settings_logo_metadata_complete.value:
("platform_settings"."invoice_logo_storage_path" IS NULL AND "platform_settings"."invoice_logo_content_type" IS NULL AND "platform_settings"."invoice_logo_sha256" IS NULL AND "platform_settings"."invoice_logo_byte_size" IS NULL)
    OR
    ("platform_settings"."invoice_logo_storage_path" IS NOT NULL AND "platform_settings"."invoice_logo_content_type" IN ('image/png', 'image/jpeg', 'image/webp') AND "platform_settings"."invoice_logo_sha256" IS NOT NULL AND "platform_settings"."invoice_logo_byte_size" > 0)

talent_genres_standardized.name: talent_genres_standardized
talent_genres_standardized.value: cardinality("talent"."genres") BETWEEN 1 AND 3 AND "talent"."genres" <@ ARRAY['Electronic/House', 'Open Format', 'Vinyl']::text[]
